case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 1125 of 2022; Special Leave Petition (Criminal) No. 3213 of 2020
summary: Batch of appeals challenging admissibility of confessions under MCOCA and validity of invoking MCOCA in FIR relating to Mumbai Matka; issues: admissibility of confessions under Section 18 MCOCA; validity of MCOCA invocation; background organized crime syndicate led by Salim Mulla; matters heard together across multiple SLPs.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Control of Organized Crime Act, 1999 (MCOCA)
Section 65(e) of the Maharashtra Prohibition Act, 1949
Section 37 and 135 of the Bombay Police Act, 1951
Banning of Unregulated Deposits Schemes Act, 2019
Sections 21(2), 21(3) and 23 of the Banning of Unregulated Deposits Schemes Act, 2019
